description: Replace an always-allow stub with a token bucket that refills fractionally over elapsed time and caps at capacity
prompts: TokenBucket.java's allow always returns true. Implement it properly: the constructor takes (double capacity, double refillRate) - `refillRate` tokens are added per second, capped at `capacity` tokens (never above it, even after a long idle period). allow(double now) refills the bucket based on elapsed seconds since the last call, then - if at least 1 token is available - consumes exactly 1 token and returns true; otherwise returns false and consumes nothing. The bucket starts full at construction time.
name: add_java_token_bucket_limiter
